_howTo: One dossier per rule VERSION. Fill every field with specifics; placeholders (TBD, n/a, example…) are rejected.
Boundary cases must cover: below_lower, at_lower, inside, at_upper, above_upper, missing_input, unit_mismatch (+ outside_population when exclusions exist).
Leave "signature" null until the named reviewer has signed THEIR OWN record; paste only its reference. The checker never approves anything.
Run: npm run validate -- rule --dossier dossier.json [--evaluator ./path/to/evaluator.js] --out report.json
